{{Quote|There's Peawp R'dawc, you can find him right here in Mos Eisley at the Combat Guild Hall. Wonderful teacher. For melee combat there's no one quite like Peawp. That's who you should be studying with.|[[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RBA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=class|Brawler|R'dawc Bodyguard Agency|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Peawp R'dawc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] and combat expert who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the owner of the [[R'dawc Bodyguard Agency]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|She is a combat expert who is leading the endeavor to rid Mos Eisley of these bothersome hoodlums. There's none better.|Mayor Mikdanyell Guh'rantt, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HHE" />}}
R'dawc was a criminal<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|84, R'dawc, Peawp}}</ref> and an expert of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]] who lived in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:RBA" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Peawp R'dawc worked for [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]], the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of Mos Eisley, and was tasked to take care of the thugs who preyed on the city.<ref name="SWG:HHE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she managed to get individuals to deal with the problem. While affiliated with [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's criminal organization]], the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] were directly employed by the Mayor Mikdanyell Guh'rantt.<ref name="SWG:HHE" /> The spacers rid the outskirts of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] of undesirable [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoopers]],<ref name="SWG:NR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|No Respect!|Tatooine}}</ref> [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]], [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture]] thieves,<ref name="SWG:MT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Moisture Thieves|Tatooine}}</ref> [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunners]],<ref name="SWG:ROtG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Run Out the Gunrunners|Tatooine}}</ref> malfunctioning [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and escaped criminals.<ref name="SWG:PI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Pod Investigations|Tatooine}}</ref> Peawp R'dawc eventually tasked the spacers to defeat [[Vaigon Shinn]]'s [[Shinn muggers|muggers]] in their [[Vaigon Shinn's Hideout|hideout]].<ref name="SWG:IT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Identity Theft|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="SWG:TaTaHOM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Thieves and Thugs and Hoodlums, Oh My!|Tatooine}}</ref> Among the spacers that did Peawp R'dawc's dirty work, [[Unidentified genetically altered Twi'lek|one of them]] was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. The latter suspected R'dawc to be a criminal working for the corrupted mayor under the guise of being a contract worker. The Imperial operative presumed that the spacers were in fact eliminating criminal rivals of Peawp R'dawc and the mayor.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Undercover%20in%20Mos%20Eisley&resource=features|text=Undercover in Mos Eisley}}</ref>

Around the same time, she also owned the [[R'dawc Bodyguard Agency]], a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] agency based in Mos Eisley. Her clients included [[Otwi Opawl]], [[Walter Orvett]] and [[Tobo]].<ref name="SWG:RBA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Peawp R'dawc was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HHE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Peawp R'dawc was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> She used to be a specialized trainer providing quests to the beginner players who had chosen a "[[W:c:swg:Brawler|brawler]]" career.<ref name="SWG:RBA" /> The "brawler" profession was later removed from the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SWG:2005" /> and Peawp R'dawc's quests were widely revamped to be available for every new players.<ref name="SWG:HHE" />

The card "Moisture Thieves" of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' misspelled her name as "Peawp R'dwac."<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Moisture Thieves}}</ref>
